_about: Every page and step the extension recognises or fills (WO32): site -> pages / steps -> selector(s) -> how it is checked. A step is UNVERIFIED ("verified": false) until a dry run on the Mac recorded it working; the Python driver publishes only when the steps it needs are verified (same gate as WO30). Pages marked verified were seen live, with when and how. The first dry run (2026-10-06) recorded what is marked verified, with what it saw ('seen').
